context.label: Testing and wilderness before Jesus’ encounter

observations.body: The people lack water, quarrel with Moses, ask whether the LORD is among them, and receive water from the rock. The place is named Massah and Meribah.
observations.label: Thirst at Massah becomes testing the LORD

observations.body: The passage presents Quarreling, testing, crying, and striking as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Quarreling, testing, crying, and striking

observations.body: The passage places Rephidim, Massah, and Meribah beside Quarreling, testing, crying, and striking.
observations.label: Rephidim, Massah, and Meribah

payload.posture: Read Exodus 17:1–7 as one movement in the temptation of Jesus, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: Real thirst and testing the LORD
payload.title: Thirst at Massah becomes testing the LORD
